properties.official_name: Jews for Jesus (SO BE IT! media channel)
properties.sample_video_title: He Tried to Ignore Jesus...But the Visions Kept Coming
properties.focus: Jewish-led evangelism; SO BE IT! is its testimony/video channel, with a staffed Tel Aviv branch.
unconfirmed: Whether 'So Be It!' is a separate legal entity: the official site only links it as a JFJ YouTube channel. The main JFJ channel is youtube.com/user/JewsForJesus (UCAq17NCfdQi07qaz70hq14w).
properties.name: So Be It! (Jews for Jesus)

properties.official_name: ONE FOR ISRAEL Ministry (Israel College of the Bible)
properties.sample_video_title: Return of the Kingdom, Episode 3 - They Will Look Upon Him
properties.focus: Israeli Messianic media evangelism and a Hebrew-language Bible college.
unconfirmed: City: the official site says only 'central Israel' and withholds the campus location for security reasons. Netanya comes from Wikipedia and ONE FOR ISRAEL's Korean site. Pin is city-level only.
properties.name: One for Israel

properties.official_name: Chosen People Ministries (Beit Sar Shalom in Israel)
properties.sample_video_title: Hebrew Word of the Week: Netzer
properties.focus: Messianic outreach centers in Israel: evangelism, discipleship, and care for Holocaust survivors.
properties.name: Chosen People Ministries

properties.official_name: Chosen People Ministries – Tel Aviv Messianic Center
properties.pin_role: Israel center (greater Tel Aviv; the official site places it in Ramat Gan)
properties.sample_video_title: Hebrew Word of the Week: Netzer
properties.focus: Young-adult outreach, concerts, Sabbath dinners and a congregation in greater Tel Aviv.
unconfirmed: Pin city: the 'Tel Aviv center' is in rented space in Ramat Gan, and the new center there is not yet dedicated (target date differs across official pages). It was damaged by missiles in June 2025.
properties.name: Chosen People Ministries

properties.focus: Israel-based ministry that supports and connects Israeli Messianic believers and leaders.
unconfirmed: HQ is Jerusalem, not Tel Aviv: the contact page says 'Our headquarters are in Jerusalem'. Focus and tags are a summary, not checked line by line against the site.
properties.name: Maoz Israel

properties.focus: Messianic Jewish Bible teaching (Arnold Fruchtenbaum, Ariel College), plus Jewish evangelism.
unconfirmed: contact_page_url: /contact returns 404, and the corporate office is listed only in the homepage footer.
youtube_channel_url and sample_video_id: the site mentions a YouTube channel, but the link couldn't be extracted because the site blocks automated fetches. A handle suggested by search returned 404.
Israel presence pin: the site lists 'Ariel Ministries Israel' with Hebrew and Russian sites but no city, so there is no Israel pin.
properties.name: Ariel Ministries

properties.official_name: CMJ Israel – Christ Church Jerusalem (Church's Ministry Among Jewish People)
properties.pin_role: CMJ Israel head office and Christ Church (Old City)
properties.sample_video_title: Chag Pesach Same'ach! A greetings from Bishop Julian Dobbs
properties.focus: Anglican mission to Jewish people; Christ Church is the oldest Protestant church in the Middle East.
unconfirmed: Organisational HQ: CMJ is a UK-founded society with a UK office in Newark, Nottinghamshire. The pin is CMJ Israel's Jerusalem head office.
'Oldest Protestant church in the Middle East' is a widely stated claim but wasn't re-checked word for word on the site.
The latest upload is from 2026-04, so the channel posts infrequently.
properties.name: CMJ (Christ Church Jerusalem)

properties.pin_role: HQ as listed on official contact page
properties.sample_video_title: The Gates of Jerusalem’s Old City
properties.focus: Connects Christians worldwide with vetted local Israeli ministries ('local partners').
unconfirmed: US base: the contact page lists only a Jerusalem address but gives a US (813, Tampa-area) phone number. A US office or legal entity wasn't confirmed, so there is no US pin.
The YouTube channel was confirmed by handle and channel title only. The official homepage blocked automated fetches, so a link from the site wasn't confirmed.
